text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: A-a reward?! I... I see... A reward...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me for being so taken aback.<n>Respect and
gratitude, I am used to,<n>but not... rewards.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh. You somehow always manage<n>to confound
my expectations.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But your sentiment is reward enough.<n>I have no
need of gifts.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
After all, what greater reward could<n>there be than
the chance to vie with<n>other Umamusume on the
track?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But of course. This victory was but a<n>single step on
my road to glory.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It is a long and arduous road, but I<n>shall not rest
until I have reached the<n>end.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And of course, you will accompany<n>me every step
of the way.
